claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for three non-jurist-preference views: (1) Citation Heritage at 21yr/137k (center_projected_64dim AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74), (2) Section Cross-Lingual at 1K sample (Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAIL; hierarchy Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen confirmed), (3) Linear Hybrid Complement at 19yr/122k (w=0.3-0.4 PASS adversarial gates, JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79). Two-mode tradeoff FUNDAMENTAL — no single representation dominates JP + LangDom + CiteIndep. True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus FAILS (AUC ~0.5). V18 coarse hierarchy NEGATIVE (max purity 0.65 < 0.7). Data blockers persist (BGE/BGER mapping, 2024-2026 parquet, 174k section extraction). All audit repairs complete. Characterization COMPLETE at max available scale.
